:question/worked-solution "Collect the common factor:

$$
\begin{aligned}
&4-8\sin^2\left(\frac{20\pi}{11}\right)\\&=4\left(1-2\sin^2\left(\frac{20\pi}{11}\right)\right)
\end{aligned}
$$

Use the alternative cosine double-angle formula:

$$
1-2\sin^2 x=\cos(2x)
$$

Substitute $x=\frac{20\pi}{11}$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
1-2\sin^2\left(\frac{20\pi}{11}\right)&=\cos\left(2\cdot \frac{20\pi}{11}\right)\\&=\cos\left(\frac{40\pi}{11}\right)
\end{aligned}
$$

Keep the outside factor:

$$
\begin{aligned}
4\left(1-2\sin^2\left(\frac{20\pi}{11}\right)\right)&=4\cos\left(\frac{40\pi}{11}\right)
\end{aligned}
$$"] [:db/add "53cc34ab-8f6b-5502-9175-b06d82df6a79" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "53cc34ab-8f6b-5502-9175-b06d82df6a79" :question/answer-fields \end{aligned}

:question/worked-solution "Collect the common factor:

$$
\begin{aligned}
&4-8\sin^2\left(\frac{20\pi}{11}\right)\\&=4\left(1-2\sin^2\left(\frac{20\pi}{11}\right)\right)
\end{aligned}
$$

Use the alternative cosine double-angle formula:

$$
1-2\sin^2 x=\cos(2x)
$$

Substitute $x=\frac{20\pi}{11}$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
1-2\sin^2\left(\frac{20\pi}{11}\right)&=\cos\left(2\cdot \frac{20\pi}{11}\right)\\&=\cos\left(\frac{40\pi}{11}\right)
\end{aligned}
$$

Keep the outside factor:

$$
\begin{aligned}
4\left(1-2\sin^2\left(\frac{20\pi}{11}\right)\right)&=4\cos\left(\frac{40\pi}{11}\right)
\end{aligned}
$$"] [:db/add "53cc34ab-8f6b-5502-9175-b06d82df6a79" :question/difficulty :question.difficulty/moderate] [:db/add "53cc34ab-8f6b-5502-9175-b06d82df6a79" :question/answer-fields
